item.title: Version 1.4.0
item.description:
New

  • raise, minimize, and tile survive title drift via frame-matched fallback
  • the Settings window gets the brand ground and honest sizing
  • Minimize All recorder, Clear Shortcut buttons, duplicate guard
  • a global Minimize All action behind a second shortcut
  • the trigger ships with no factory shortcut
  • the Quit All dialog names the locked apps it will skip
  • localize the permission prompts; drop dead weight
  • onboarding records the shortcut and scopes what it claims
  • give the Settings window a branded header
  • add the brand palette and the Settings header band
  • launching MissionPlus while it runs opens Settings
  • offer thumbnails from the grid and from Settings
  • make the no-thumbnail card icon-forward
  • let onboarding's Screen Recording step be skipped
  • gate the overlay on Accessibility alone, not Screen Recording
  • the onboarding hotkey step confirms the conflict is gone
  • record the global trigger in Settings, and warn on real conflicts
  • adopt KeyboardShortcuts 3.0.1 for the global trigger
  • attach dSYMs to the GitHub release for crash symbolication
  • generate Sparkle/GitHub release notes from conventional commits
  • detect live system hotkey conflicts from AppleSymbolicHotKeys
  • add LoginItemService as the single source of truth for login-item state
  • failed cards stay put, shake once, and say so
  • bulk close/quit preserve batch integrity and stop dismissing over failures
  • quitApp reconciles terminate()'s 'request sent' against reality
  • closeWindow reports accepted/rejected/blocked instead of always animating success
  • detect blocking AX sheets behind the WindowActing seam

Fixed

  • the archive signs KeyboardShortcuts' resource bundle with the team
  • the tagger's own listing was the third SIGPIPE landmine
  • version-bump detection survives pipefail and ignores prose mentions
  • app activation becomes a verified cooperative handoff
  • the superseded lock note stays manual, not stale
  • pin the Settings content to the window's top edge
  • a hide during the permission check wins over the in-flight show
  • restore the app-activate fallback when an AX raise fails
  • close five holes in the localization catalog guards
  • mark the 24 unprotected live catalog keys as manual
  • close two lint holes in LocalizationCatalogTests
  • stop flagging 46 live catalog keys as stale
  • deep-link call sites hide the overlay unconditionally
  • two silent-failure gaps in the overlay's gear popover
  • the gear popover says when Launch at Login needs approval
  • debug builds stop offering to overwrite themselves
  • Settings refreshes when you come back, instead of polling forever
  • refcount the polling token so two owners cannot cancel each other
  • avoid rewriting hasRequestedScreenRecording on every poll tick
  • make Screen Recording onboarding copy true on both request branches
  • close drift-guard hole in NSAccessibilityUsageDescription test
  • Accessibility is not what quits your apps
  • seed hasRequestedScreenRecording flag from observed grants
  • stop racing the system's own Screen Recording prompt
  • onboarding hotkey step pill and duplicate advice for no-shortcut state
  • a skipped onboarding step no longer renders as upcoming
  • the menu bar and help popover show the recorded shortcut
  • no shortcut is not the same as no conflict
  • force layout before centering Settings window; close it synchronously
  • poll LoginItemService status; move overlay guard into MenuBarController
  • Launch at Login says when it is waiting on your approval
  • Minimize All stays open when a window refuses to minimize
  • a refused tile or raise marks the card instead of dismissing
  • match tag-release.sh's BREAKING CHANGE detection; escape HTML in notes
  • Info.plist admits what Accessibility is actually used for
  • discard unused withAnimation results; prune failure marks on app termination
